criteria.description: The criteria text sent to the decision model: when a caller's words mean this intent ("Wants to cancel an existing appointment"). Sent as it is, so a change re-keys a recorded cassette.

label.description: The spoken label ("track a parcel"), used in acknowledgements and confirmations ("I'd be happy to help you track a parcel").

kind.description: form: starts the form of the same id in forms.yaml. informational: plays its promptId and resumes. control: the engine's own (agent, repeat_prompt, done, other, none).

promptId.description: For an informational intent, the prompt played (an id in prompts.yaml).

intents.description: Every intent the app hears, by id, in the order the decision model is offered them. Each form intent has a form of the same id in forms.yaml; `agent` and `repeat_prompt` are required control intents.

digit.description: The key the caller presses, as a quoted string ("1"; an unquoted 1 is a number in YAML).

intent.description: The intent that key chooses (an id under `intents`).

items.description: One key of the keypad menu.

menu.description: The keypad menu: digit to intent, in the order it is read out. May be empty for an app with no keypad menu.

description: intents.yaml: what a caller can ask for, and the keypad menu.
title: DialogWright intents.yaml
